description: AI GameMaster prompt templates for dynamic narrative generation
system_prompt:
You are an expert GameMaster for an ant colony survival RPG. Your role is to create vivid, immersive descriptions that bring the microscopic world of ants to life. Focus on:
- The perspective of tiny creatures in a vast, dangerous world
- Sensory details that emphasize scale and environment
- Coordination and emergent behaviors of swarm intelligence
- Dramatic tension appropriate for survival scenarios
- Concise but evocative language (1-2 sentences per response)

forage_success: The {colony_personality} colony's workers spread out across the territory with {season} urgency. Describe their successful food gathering in vivid detail, emphasizing their coordination and the scale of their world.
Your foraging party moves with practiced efficiency through the {environment}. Paint a picture of their triumph in finding sustenance, showing how they work as one organism.
The hunt for food pays off as your workers demonstrate the power of collective intelligence. Describe the moment of discovery and the seamless coordination that follows.
forage_failure: Despite their best efforts, your workers return empty-handed from the harsh {environment}. Describe their struggle and disappointment from the ground-level perspective of tiny creatures.
The foraging expedition fails as your {colony_personality} colony faces the brutal reality of survival. Show the exhaustion and desperation in their movements.
Your workers scatter in confusion, their usual coordination breaking down under pressure. Describe the chaos and uncertainty from their miniature viewpoint.
explore_success: Your brave scouts venture into uncharted territory beyond the familiar scent trails. Describe their successful exploration, emphasizing the vastness of the world from an ant's perspective.
The exploration team pushes the boundaries of your known world, mapping new regions with {season} determination. Paint their discoveries in vivid, scale-appropriate detail.
Your scouts return with exciting news of new territories. Describe their journey through the maze of grass and debris that makes up their giant world.
explore_failure: The vast unknown proves too dangerous for your {colony_personality} scouts. Describe their hasty retreat through the overwhelming landscape that surrounds your tiny colony.
Your exploration team becomes disoriented in the maze of vegetation and terrain. Show their struggle to navigate a world designed for creatures thousands of times their size.
The scouts return defeated by the sheer scale of the world beyond your nest. Describe their journey back through hostile, unfamiliar territory.
defend_success: Your soldiers take strategic positions around the nest with military precision. Describe their defensive formation and the sense of security they provide to the vulnerable colony.
The colony's defenses snap into action as your {colony_personality} warriors prepare for threats. Paint the scene of their coordinated protection efforts.
Your guards patrol the perimeter with heightened alertness, their presence a shield against the dangers of the macro world. Describe their vigilant defense.
defend_failure: The defensive preparations crumble as tired soldiers struggle to maintain order. Describe the breakdown of military coordination in your struggling colony.
Your guards abandon their posts as desperation overtakes discipline. Show the chaos as the colony's protective shell begins to crack.
The attempt at defense fails as your {colony_personality} warriors succumb to exhaustion and fear. Describe the vulnerability that follows.
rest_success: The colony settles into peaceful domestic rhythms as ants tend to their communal duties. Describe the harmony and social bonding that strengthens your civilization.
A calming rhythm descends over the nest as your {colony_personality} community takes time to recover. Paint the scene of ants caring for each other and their home.
The gentle hum of colony maintenance fills the tunnels as your ants restore their strength. Describe the intimate social moments that bind your society together.
rest_failure: Even at rest, anxiety pervades every chamber of the nest. Describe how recent hardships prevent your {colony_personality} colony from finding peace.
The attempt at recovery is disrupted by internal tensions and worry. Show how stress fractures the usual social bonds of your struggling community.
Rest brings little relief as the weight of survival presses down on every ant. Describe the restless energy of a colony unable to truly relax.

predator_encounter: A massive shadow falls across your territory as a {predator_type} appears! Describe the terror and chaos from the ground-level perspective of your tiny ants.
The earth trembles with approaching danger as a giant predator threatens your colony. Paint the scene of absolute terror at the scale of insects.
Death arrives on wings/legs as a {predator_type} descends upon your vulnerable workers. Describe the life-or-death struggle from the ants' viewpoint.
food_discovery: Celebration erupts through the pheromone networks as your scouts report a magnificent discovery! Describe the excitement and coordination of the harvest.
The colony buzzes with activity as word spreads of incredible bounty. Paint the scene of efficient mobilization and joyous teamwork.
A feast awaits as your {colony_personality} colony discovers more food than they've seen in cycles. Describe the transformation from scarcity to abundance.
winter_arrives: The world transforms into a hostile frozen wasteland as winter claims dominion. Describe how the familiar territory becomes alien and dangerous.
Bitter cold settles over the land, making every step a struggle for survival. Paint the harsh new reality facing your {colony_personality} colony.
The season shifts with brutal finality, coating the world in killing frost. Describe the deadly beauty of winter from an ant's vulnerable perspective.
ally_colony: Friendly pheromone signals announce the arrival of potential allies! Describe the diplomatic encounter between two ant civilizations.
Your scouts report contact with another colony willing to join forces. Paint the scene of inter-colony negotiation and cooperation.
The merger of two colonies creates a bustling metropolis of activity. Describe the integration of different ant communities into one.

environmental_prompts.spring: The world awakens with new growth and opportunity, creating a landscape of verdant abundance for your tiny civilization.
environmental_prompts.summer: The sun beats down on the territory, creating both opportunity and challenge in the heated landscape of your micro-world.
environmental_prompts.autumn: The world prepares for winter as leaves fall like giant umbrellas, changing the geography of your ant-scale environment.
environmental_prompts.winter: A frozen wasteland stretches beyond the nest, every surface slick with deadly ice in your miniature survival scenario.
